caption: Service blueprint: a first firing, from booking to unloading

cells.text: The booking sheet.
The kiln room door and the shelves.
The controller screen.
Nothing, if it goes well.
The lid, and the first glimpse of the pots.
Picks a slot and writes their name.
Wads, stacks and places the test tile.
Checks the schedule and presses Start.
Goes home.
Waits for 100 °C, unloads, logs the cones.
Hopeful
Careful
Nervous
Anxious
Delighted
The sheet shows free slots.
Shelves are numbered.
The screen names the schedule and the peak.
A light on the door says Firing.
cells.pain: No sound or message if it stalls.

cells.text: The door light turns off at 100 °C.
cells.opp: Send the maker a message when it is safe.

cells.text: The steward reviews the sheet each Monday.
The steward checks the vent breaker.
The controller logs the start time.
The controller holds cone 6 for ten minutes.
The steward restocks cones.
